title.zh: 2026年试验研究比较历史砖砌体的修复砂浆、碳纤维织物和喷涂聚脲
title.en: A 2026 study compares mortar, carbon textile, and sprayed polyurea for historic brick masonry

summary.zh: 伊斯坦布尔技术大学研究团队对历史砖砌体试件进行材料表征和结构试验，比较修复砂浆、碳纤维织物和喷涂聚脲对剪切、变形和破坏模式的影响。行业意义在于，历史建筑加固正在从“增加强度”转向同时考虑低侵入性、延性、可逆性和原材料保护。对工程师而言，方案选择不能只看峰值承载力，还要看界面粘结、刚度突变、湿热环境、施工可达性和维护责任。
summary.en: A 2026 Istanbul Technical University study characterises historic brick masonry and compares restoration mortar, carbon textile, and sprayed polyurea under structural tests. The industry signal is that heritage retrofit is moving beyond adding strength toward low invasiveness, ductility, reversibility, and protection of original fabric. Engineers should not select an intervention by peak capacity alone; interface bond, stiffness change, environmental exposure, access, and maintenance responsibility also govern.

watch.zh: 关注新型加固材料能否同时证明结构收益、耐久性和对历史材料的兼容性。
watch.en: Watch whether new retrofit materials demonstrate structural benefit, durability, and compatibility with historic fabric together.

title.zh: Heritage-BIM结合深度学习识别砌体缺陷，历史建筑维护开始形成数据闭环
title.en: Heritage-BIM and deep learning are forming a data loop for masonry defect management

summary.zh: 利物浦大学研究提出面向砌体遗产建筑的缺陷增强Heritage-BIM方法，尝试用深度学习分割裂缝、剥落和其他缺陷。这个方向的价值不在于让算法替代工程师，而在于把巡检影像、缺陷位置、构件身份和维修记录连接起来。对资产管理团队，真正需要解决的是训练样本不平衡、缺陷分类标准、现场光照和模型外推，以及算法结果如何触发人工复核和维修优先级。数字化只有进入结构判断和维护流程，才会形成可持续收益。
summary.en: A University of Liverpool study proposes a defect-augmented Heritage-BIM method for masonry heritage, using deep learning to segment cracks, spalling, and other defects. Its value is not replacing engineers with algorithms; it is connecting inspection images, defect location, member identity, and repair records. Asset teams still need to address imbalanced training samples, defect taxonomy, field lighting, extrapolation, and how automated outputs trigger human review and maintenance priority. Digitalisation creates durable value only when it enters structural judgement and maintenance workflow.

watch.zh: 关注缺陷识别结果是否能回到具体构件、风险等级和维修记录，而不是停在图像分类。
watch.en: Watch whether defect recognition links back to members, risk levels, and repair records rather than stopping at image classification.

title.zh: 2026年综述梳理无筋砌体加固技术，强调材料选择必须服从建筑类型和环境
title.en: A 2026 review maps unreinforced-masonry retrofit methods and puts context before material choice

summary.zh: Springer旗下Discover Civil Engineering发表的2026年综述系统梳理无筋砌体结构的加固技术和试验研究，指出材料选择应结合砌体类型、历史价值、荷载条件和环境暴露。对行业而言，这意味着FRP、织物砂浆、灌浆、喷涂材料或局部替换都不是可以脱离背景直接复制的产品方案。设计师需要把原结构机理、加固后刚度变化、连接细节、施工质量和后续检查一起评估，尤其要避免新加固层改变原有结构的破坏模式。
summary.en: A 2026 review in Discover Civil Engineering maps retrofit methods and experimental research for unreinforced masonry, emphasising that material choice must follow masonry type, heritage value, loading, and exposure. FRP, textile mortar, grout, sprayed materials, and local replacement are not transferable product solutions without context. Designers need to assess original mechanics, post-retrofit stiffness, connections, construction quality, and inspection together, especially where a new layer could change the original failure mode.

watch.zh: 关注加固设计是否同时评价原结构机理、加固后破坏模式和长期可维护性。
watch.en: Watch whether retrofit design evaluates original mechanics, post-retrofit failure modes, and long-term maintainability together.

title.zh: 历史砌体的难点不是没有公式，而是材料、施工和损伤历史无法被一个标准参数代表
title.en: The challenge in historic masonry is not a lack of equations but the limits of one standard parameter set

insights.evidence: 2026 experimental study of a strengthened scaled masonry arch–vault–wall system

summary.zh: 历史砌体的材料差异、施工工艺、既有损伤和加固历史会显著影响结构响应。2026年对拱—穹顶—墙体缩尺系统的试验研究采用破坏性和非破坏性检测，并按预定顺序评价整体响应，说明复杂砌体不能只依靠单块砖或单片墙的强度试验。对结构工程师，关键能力是把现场调查、材料检测、整体模型和加固后验证结合起来，同时保留不确定性。缩尺试验有助于识别机制，但尺寸效应、边界条件和真实施工误差仍需单独论证。
summary.en: Material variability, construction technique, accumulated damage, and retrofit history strongly influence historic masonry response. A 2026 study tested a scaled arch–vault–wall system using destructive and non-destructive methods in a defined sequence, showing why complex masonry cannot be represented by one brick or wall-strength test. Engineers need to connect field survey, material testing, global modelling, and post-retrofit verification while retaining uncertainty. Scaled tests clarify mechanisms, but size effects, boundary conditions, and real construction tolerances still require separate justification.

caveat.zh: 缩尺和试验室结果不能直接代表整座历史建筑；模型必须回到现场几何、边界和材料证据。
caveat.en: Scaled and laboratory results do not directly represent a whole historic building; models must return to field geometry, boundaries, and material evidence.

title.zh: Heritage-BIM的工程价值取决于缺陷语义和维护责任，而不只是三维模型精度
title.en: Heritage-BIM becomes useful through defect semantics and maintenance responsibility, not geometry alone

insights.evidence: University of Liverpool research on deep-learning defect segmentation for heritage masonry

summary.zh: 砌体缺陷识别若要服务结构安全，必须把裂缝、剥落、潮湿、材料脱落和连接损伤映射到可追踪的构件身份和维修动作。Liverpool研究指出，复杂缺陷场景中的样本量、类别不平衡和分类标准会限制深度学习模型表现。对未来结构工程师，数字能力不只是会使用点云或BIM，而是能定义缺陷字典、证据等级、人工复核和版本记录，使模型输出能够支持检查和风险排序。算法表现不能替代现场责任，也不能自动给出承载力结论。
summary.en: For defect recognition to support structural safety, cracks, spalling, moisture, material loss, and connection damage must map to traceable member identities and repair actions. The Liverpool research highlights sample size, class imbalance, and unclear taxonomy as limitations in complex defect scenes. For future structural engineers, digital capability means more than using point clouds or BIM; it means defining defect vocabulary, evidence levels, human review, and version history so outputs support inspection and risk ranking. Algorithm performance cannot replace field responsibility or automatically produce a capacity conclusion.

caveat.zh: 图像分割是识别工具，不是结构诊断；缺陷严重程度仍需结合位置、深度、机理和现场复核。
caveat.en: Image segmentation is an identification tool, not a structural diagnosis; severity still requires location, depth, mechanism, and field review.

title.zh: 砌体加固的未来不是最强材料，而是与原结构相容、可检查和可维修的干预
title.en: The future of masonry retrofit is compatible, inspectable, and repairable intervention rather than the strongest material

insights.evidence: 2026 review of unreinforced-masonry retrofit techniques and heritage intervention studies

summary.zh: 既有砌体加固同时面对安全、耐久、文化价值和施工扰动约束。2026年研究综述和遗产干预研究都强调，材料选择要结合砌体类型、原结构机理和环境暴露；加固层过硬、过重或过于刚性，可能把损伤转移到原墙体、界面或基础。对结构工程师，方案评价应包括强度、延性、刚度变化、粘结、可逆性、施工质量和维修入口，而不是只比较极限荷载。低侵入设计仍需明确性能目标和验收方法。
summary.en: Masonry retrofit must balance safety, durability, cultural value, and construction disruption. The 2026 review and heritage-intervention studies emphasise that materials must suit masonry type, original mechanics, and exposure. A retrofit layer that is too strong, heavy, or stiff may transfer damage into the original wall, interface, or foundation. Engineers should evaluate strength, ductility, stiffness change, bond, reversibility, construction quality, and maintenance access rather than ultimate load alone. Low-invasive design still needs explicit performance objectives and acceptance methods.

caveat.zh: 可逆性和低侵入性不是自动安全；加固后整体受力与界面耐久性仍需试验或可靠模型支持。
caveat.en: Reversibility and low invasiveness are not automatically safe; post-retrofit global action and interface durability still need tests or reliable models.

insights.reference: Springer review on masonry retrofit and heritage intervention research

title.zh: 砌体墙不是“砖的堆叠”：中国与国际设计如何处理墙体、整体性和加固相容性？
title.en: A masonry wall is not a stack of bricks: how Chinese and international design treat wall action, integrity, and retrofit compatibility

text.zh: 砌体结构的受力性能来自砖、块材、砂浆、墙体几何、楼板或屋盖连接以及整体性共同作用。中国、欧洲和美国规范虽然在材料等级、墙体强度、稳定和抗震构造上使用不同术语，但共同关注墙体的轴压、面外稳定、平面内剪切和构件之间的传力。既有历史砌体还要增加材料离散、施工缺陷、损伤和保护要求。加固不能只把墙体强度提高，因为新层与旧墙之间的刚度和变形不相容可能改变破坏模式。工程比较的重点应是力学机制、边界、整体性和可维护性，而不是一个孤立的砌体强度数字。
text.en: Masonry behaviour comes from the interaction of units, mortar, wall geometry, floor or roof connections, and system integrity. Chinese, European, and US provisions use different terminology for material classes, wall strength, stability, and seismic detailing, but all address axial compression, out-of-plane stability, in-plane shear, and load transfer between elements. Historic masonry adds variability, workmanship defects, damage, and conservation constraints. Strengthening cannot simply increase wall strength: stiffness and deformation incompatibility between new and old layers may change the failure mode. A useful comparison focuses on mechanics, boundaries, integrity, and maintainability rather than one isolated masonry-strength value.

label.zh: 材料强度不等于墙体能力
label.en: Material strength is not wall capacity

text.zh: 墙体长细比、偏心、开洞、砂浆接缝、楼板约束和面外支撑会共同决定实际能力。
text.en: Slenderness, eccentricity, openings, mortar joints, floor restraint, and out-of-plane support jointly govern actual wall capacity.

label.zh: 整体性决定荷载能否重新分配

text.zh: 墙体与楼板、圈梁、相邻墙和屋盖的连接不足时，局部损伤可能无法通过整体体系扩散。
text.en: Without adequate connection to floors, ring beams, adjacent walls, and roofs, local damage may not be redistributed through the system.

label.zh: 加固相容性和强度同样重要
label.en: Compatibility matters as much as strength

text.zh: 新加固层的刚度、透气性、热湿变形和粘结应与原墙体共同评估，避免把损伤推向界面。
text.en: The retrofit layer's stiffness, permeability, hygrothermal movement, and bond should be assessed with the original wall to avoid transferring damage to the interface.

takeaway.zh: 砌体设计的第一步不是查一个砖或砂浆强度，而是确认墙体如何传力、如何获得整体性，以及加固后新旧材料是否能够共同变形。
takeaway.en: The first step in masonry design is not looking up one brick or mortar strength; it is confirming the wall load path, system integrity, and whether old and new materials can deform together after retrofit.

title.zh: 参考实例：砌体墙轴压利用系数的概念筛查
title.en: Worked reference: conceptual axial-utilisation screening for a masonry wall

intro.zh: 以下关系用于说明砌体墙评估的概念流程，属于派生关系和简化筛查，不是某一规范条文的逐字转录。正式设计应按适用规范确定墙体强度、偏心、稳定、开洞、楼板约束和材料离散。
intro.en: The relations below explain a conceptual masonry-wall assessment. They are derived relations and simplified screens, not verbatim reproductions of one code clause. Formal design must determine wall strength, eccentricity, stability, openings, floor restraint, and material variability under the applicable standard.

label.zh: 轴向平均压应力（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：用轴力N与有效受压面积A表示平均压应力；实际墙体还需考虑偏心、局部承压和非均匀应力。
citation.en: Derived relation: expresses average compression from axial force N and effective compression area A. Actual walls also require eccentricity, local bearing, and non-uniform stress checks.

label.zh: 砌体墙名义抗压能力（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：以砌体设计强度fₘ和有效面积Aₑ表示概念抗力；正式设计必须采用适用规范的墙体、稳定和偏心修正。
citation.en: Derived relation: represents conceptual resistance using masonry design strength fₘ and effective area Aₑ. Formal design must apply wall, stability, and eccentricity provisions in the relevant standard.

citation.zh: Simplified screen：表示设计作用效应与设计抗力的比值；η不应被当作所有国家规范通用的验收常数，具体安全格式和限值必须按适用规范确定。
citation.en: Simplified screen: expresses design action effect divided by design resistance. η is not a universal acceptance constant; the safety format and limit must come from the applicable standard.

note.zh: 例如，若设计轴力Eᵈ=360 kN、按现状检测和适用规范得到设计抗力Rᵈ=500 kN，则概念利用系数η=0.72。这个筛查仍不能替代面外稳定、剪切、开洞、连接、基础和加固相容性检查。
note.en: For example, if the design axial action is Eᵈ=360 kN and the design resistance from condition evidence and the applicable standard is Rᵈ=500 kN, the conceptual utilisation is η=0.72. This does not replace checks of out-of-plane stability, shear, openings, connections, foundations, or retrofit compatibility.
